name: ci-test/wrong-verdict
title: Group basics
summary: First facts about groups, checked line by line.

entries.title: The inverse of an inverse
entries.source:
Theorem: "Inverse of an inverse"
Proof:
    Assume Group(G, op, e, inv)
    Given a : G
    Step: op(inv(a), a) = e
    Therefore inv(inv(a)) = a
QED

entries.title: Every group is abelian
entries.explanation: Nothing in the group axioms makes op commutative; that is what an abelian group adds.
entries.source:
Assume Group(G, op, e, inv)
Let a, b : G
Step: op(a, b) = op(b, a)
